Several hours (9 missions and lots of travelling)

The shaman {npc:Hairycles}, of Banuta, wants to find true friends among humans. Over 9 missions you go to Trapwood, Carlin, Chor, Ankrahmun, Fibula, the Forbidden Lands and the depths of Banuta to cure the apes' plague and destroy the serpent god's monument. At the end you get the {wiki:Shaman Outfits|Shaman Outfits}, monkey statues for your house and access to the Forbidden Lands and Deeper Banuta.
